title: Holdings & Performance
description: Every priced holding: units, cost, current price, market value, gain/loss, and weight — plus purchase lots and price history for a selected holding.

widgets.title: Holdings
widgets.helpText: Sortable. Gain/loss compares the latest recorded price to cost basis; weight is each holding's share of the portfolio. Use the Holding picker to drill into lots and price history below. Holdings with no recorded price are not shown.

steps.query: WITH latest AS (SELECT base_currency, quote_currency, CAST(quote_number AS REAL) AS price FROM prices x WHERE x.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM prices y WHERE y.base_currency = x.base_currency AND y.quote_currency = x.quote_currency)), agg AS (SELECT l.units_currency AS holding, c.asset_class AS asset_class, SUM(CAST(l.units_number AS REAL)) AS units, SUM(CAST(l.book_value AS REAL)) AS cost_basis FROM lots l JOIN commodities c ON c.code = l.units_currency AND c.is_currency = 0 WHERE l.cost_currency = :currency GROUP BY l.units_currency, c.asset_class), joined AS (SELECT agg.holding, agg.asset_class, ROUND(agg.units, 4) AS units, ROUND(agg.cost_basis / agg.units, 2) AS avg_cost, ROUND(agg.cost_basis, 2) AS cost_basis, lt.price AS last_price, ROUND(agg.units * lt.price, 2) AS market_value, ROUND(agg.units * lt.price - agg.cost_basis, 2) AS unrealized, CASE WHEN agg.cost_basis != 0 THEN (agg.units * lt.price - agg.cost_basis) / agg.cost_basis END AS unrealized_pct, agg.units * lt.price AS mv_raw FROM agg JOIN latest lt ON lt.base_currency = agg.holding AND lt.quote_currency = :currency) SELECT holding, asset_class, units, avg_cost, cost_basis, last_price, market_value, unrealized, unrealized_pct, mv_raw / SUM(mv_raw) OVER () AS weight FROM joined ORDER BY market_value DESC

visualization.emptyText: No priced holdings in this currency yet. Add holdings with cost lots and prices, then pick a currency that has data.

widgets.title: Market Value by Holding
widgets.helpText: Each holding's current market value, largest at top. Click a bar to see that holding's transactions.

steps.query: SELECT l.units_currency AS holding, ROUND(SUM(CAST(l.units_number AS REAL) * lp.price), 2) AS value FROM lots l JOIN commodities c ON c.code = l.units_currency AND c.is_currency = 0 JOIN (SELECT base_currency, quote_currency, CAST(quote_number AS REAL) AS price FROM prices x WHERE x.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM prices y WHERE y.base_currency = x.base_currency AND y.quote_currency = x.quote_currency)) lp ON lp.base_currency = l.units_currency AND lp.quote_currency = :currency GROUP BY l.units_currency HAVING value > 0 ORDER BY value ASC

visualization.emptyText: No priced holdings in this currency yet.

widgets.title: Purchase Lots
widgets.helpText: The remaining lots of the selected holding — when each was acquired, how many units, and at what cost.

steps.query: SELECT acquisition_date, ROUND(CAST(units_number AS REAL), 4) AS units, CAST(cost_number AS REAL) AS cost, ROUND(CAST(book_value AS REAL), 2) AS book_value FROM lots WHERE units_currency = :holding ORDER BY acquisition_date

visualization.emptyText: Pick a holding above to see its purchase lots.

widgets.title: Price History
widgets.helpText: Recorded prices for the selected holding over time.

steps.query: SELECT date, CAST(quote_number AS REAL) AS price FROM prices WHERE base_currency = :holding AND quote_currency = :currency ORDER BY date

visualization.emptyText: Pick a holding above to see its price history.
